user.title: New recording profile
user.description: A profile decides which cameras record into which folder. You can pick any camera that is already set up in Home Assistant, and use the same camera in several profiles. A camera never records in two profiles at the same time though, the first profile to start keeps it. In the file name pattern you can use the placeholders cam (camera), short (short code) and profile (profile), each in curly braces, plus date and time with %CCYY %MM %DD %hh %mm %ss.

data.name: Name (e.g. Stairs)
data.folder: Target folder (pick one or type your own, subfolders like Security/Stairs work too)

user_when.title: When to record?
user_when.description: These are the creation values of the profile. Without triggers and without a restriction (weekdays, times, sun) the profile only starts by hand. With a restriction but no trigger it records continuously during that time. With triggers it records as long as one is "on" and the restriction fits. You set the weekdays and their times in the next step. You can override run-on, maximum length, weekdays, times and sun later on the profile's device page without changing these values.

reconfigure.title: Edit recording profile
reconfigure.description: These are the creation values of the profile. Whatever you overrode on the profile's device page (currently: {overridden}) is not touched by this and stays in effect until you press "Reset to creation values" there. In the file name pattern you can use the placeholders cam (camera), short (short code) and profile (profile), each in curly braces, plus date and time with %CCYY %MM %DD %hh %mm %ss.

data.name: Name (e.g. Stairs)
data.folder: Target folder (pick one or type your own, subfolders like Security/Stairs work too)

reconfigure_when.title: When to record?
reconfigure_when.description: These are the creation values of the profile. Without triggers and without a restriction (weekdays, times, sun) the profile only starts by hand. With a restriction but no trigger it records continuously during that time. With triggers it records as long as one is "on" and the restriction fits. Whatever you overrode on the profile's device page (currently: {overridden}) is not touched by this until you press "Reset to creation values" there.

user_days.title: Which days and when?
user_days.description: Switch on every day on which to record and optionally add the times, for example 08:00-12:00, 18:00-22:00 (several separated by commas, also across midnight like 22:00-06:00, a window across midnight belongs to the day it starts on). Without times the day records all day. With all days off the profile never records on its own, by hand still works. Only the "Save profile" button saves the profile.

Whatever you overrode on the profile's device page (currently: {overridden}) is not touched by this until you press "Reset to creation values" there. Only the "Save profile" button saves the changes.
